answer: Each identity answers timestamped pings from ten peers chosen by VRF daily; the protocol multi-laterates its position from these receipts, and identities within 50 km share one cluster whose reward splits by member count squared, so duplication shrinks per-head income. Distinct coordinates force attackers to rent exit nodes on separate autonomous systems, ~$15 per node monthly; beyond four members per cluster, per-head rewards fall below that. Like a reef, identity must anchor to real substrate, or the economy turns karst and the fable that identity is free survives.
